subtitle: Lesson 8 · Users and Access

caption: Network Access controls org-wide trusted IPs; Login Access Policies and Login Hours live one level down, on each profile.
A Start/End IP range on a profile is absolute — a user outside it can't log in at all, no verification code to fall back on.
Open any profile and you'll find Login Hours and Login IP Ranges as related settings — this is why Profile matters so much.
